era_en: 1689-1755: Bordeaux, France — Paris — travels in England (1729-1731) — the château of La Brède
school: 启蒙运动；政治社会学与比较制度分析的开创者
historical_significance: 启蒙时代法国政治哲学家孟德斯鸠（1689-1755）是现代政治科学与比较制度分析的奠基人。代表作《论法的精神》（1748）把法律从神意与君权的宣示改写为『与事物性质相适应的关系体系』，以数百个跨文明案例建立政体类型学（共和-君主-专制）并配以原则动力分析（德性-荣誉-恐惧）；其三权分立与『以权力约束权力』的理论经《联邦党人文集》进入美国宪法，成为现代宪政的核心范式；他对自由的法律定义（自由是做法律所许可之事的权利）、对中间权力的辩护、对商业文明『柔和风俗』的分析、对气候-制度关系的首次系统变量化处理，共同奠定了历史社会学与政治经济学的比较方法。他直接影响了美国制宪者与法国大革命前的改革派，是启蒙思想家中对现代制度设计影响最直接的一位。
historical_significance_en: Montesquieu (1689-1755), French political philosopher of the Enlightenment, founded modern political science and comparative institutional analysis. The Spirit of the Laws (1748) rewrote law from a proclamation of divine will or sovereign command into a system of 'relations arising from the nature of things,' building a typology of regimes (republic, monarchy, despotism) paired with an analysis of animating principles (virtue, honor, fear) across hundreds of cross-civilizational cases. His theory of separation of powers—power must check power—entered the U.S. Constitution via The Federalist and became the core paradigm of modern constitutionalism. His legal definition of liberty (liberty is the right to do what the laws permit), his defense of intermediate powers, his analysis of commerce's 'sweetening' of mores, and the first systematic variable-treatment of climate-institution relations together laid the comparative method of historical sociology and political economy. He directly influenced the American framers and pre-revolutionary French reformers—the Enlightenment thinker whose influence on modern institutional design was the most immediate.
unique_thinking: 把制度问题彻底『关系化』与『情境化』的第一人。核心方法论：其一，一切制度分析从关系出发——法的精神不在条文而在法与政体、经济、风俗、地理诸情境的关系总和，因此评判与移植制度必须先做关系配型；其二，结构优先于德性——对权力的约束不寄望于统治者的品质，而寄望于『以权力约束权力』的结构安排，为最坏的掌权者设计制度；其三，原则动力学——政体的存续取决于其原则（德性、荣誉、恐惧）的存量，诊断政体就是诊断其原则的耗竭速度；其四，温和作为工程纪律——立法的最高德性是免除极端，改革失败的第一原因不是方向而是剂量；其五，把环境（气候、地理）作为带机制、带边界的变量纳入社会科学，同时以身示范给变量设界。这五条合成的独特思维：制度是可分析、可比较、可移植但必须先做适配检验的对象——政治从道德写作变成为工程学科。
unique_thinking_en: The first thinker to fully 'relationalize' and 'situationalize' institutions. Core methodology: first, all institutional analysis starts from relations—the spirit of law lies not in clauses but in the sum of law's relations with regime, economy, mores, and geography, so judging or transplanting institutions requires compatibility testing of relations first. Second, structure over virtue: restraint on power rests not on rulers' character but on the structural arrangement of 'power checking power'—design institutions for the worst officeholder. Third, principle dynamics: a regime's survival depends on the stock of its principle (virtue, honor, fear); to diagnose a regime is to diagnose the rate at which its principle is being consumed. Fourth, moderation as engineering discipline: the legislator's highest virtue is the exclusion of extremes, and the first cause of reform failure is not direction but dosage. Fifth, treating environment (climate, geography) as a variable with mechanisms and bounds in social science, while personally demonstrating how to bound it. The five together compose a singular mind: institutions are objects that can be analyzed, compared, and transplanted—but only after adaptation testing; politics thereby passed from moral writing to an engineering discipline.
civilization_zh: 西方文明（法兰西—启蒙运动）
key_works: 《罗马盛衰原因论》(Considérations sur les causes de la grandeur des Romains et de leur décadence, 1734)
《论法的精神》辩护 (Défense de L'Esprit des lois, 1750)
《随笔与 fragments》（若干政治与人类学笔记，身后整理）

modes.domain_zh: 把政府权力拆分为立法、行政、司法三个独立分支并使其相互牵制，从结构上防止权力集中
modes.domain_en: Splitting governmental power into independent legislative, executive, and judicial branches that restrain one another, preventing concentration by structure rather than by virtue
modes.definition_zh: 孟德斯鸠对政治学的最大贡献，是把自由问题从『谁来统治』改写为『权力如何被组织』。他在《论法的精神》第十一章第六节的论断是：一切有权力的人都容易滥用权力，这是万古不易的经验；要防止滥用权力，就必须以权力约束权力。他考察英格兰政体后得出：政治自由只存在于权力不被滥用之处，而立法权、行政权、司法权若集中于同一人或同一机构——无论此人是谁、无论机构是世袭的还是选举的——自由便不复存在。方法上有三步：其一，权力清点——把一个政体内实际运行的权力按其功能（造法、执法、裁判）分解，而不是按其名义分类；其二，交叉牵制设计——让每一分支对另一分支握有局部否决或制衡手段（行政机关对立法的否决权、立法机关对行政的弹劾权），使任何一支都无法单独压倒其余；其三，防止合并——制衡的真正目的不是让三支权力和谐，而是让它们『被迫合作、无法合并』，因为联合即暴政的开端。这一方法的深意是：对权力的约束不能建立在统治者的德性假设上，而要建立在结构假设上——制度必须为最坏的掌权者设计，而不是为最好的。
modes.definition_en: Montesquieu's greatest contribution to political science was recasting the question of liberty from 'who shall rule' to 'how power is organized.' In Book XI, chapter 6 of The Spirit of the Laws he states: constant experience shows that every man invested with power is apt to abuse it; to prevent this abuse, power must check power. Examining the English constitution he concluded that political liberty exists only where power is not abused, and that if legislative, executive, and judicial power were united in the same person or body—whatever that person, whether hereditary or elected—liberty would be gone. The method has three steps. First, inventory power: decompose the actually operating powers of a polity by function (making, executing, judging law), not by nominal label. Second, design cross-restraints: give each branch partial veto or checking means over the others (executive veto over legislation, legislative impeachment of the executive), so that no single branch can overwhelm the rest. Third, prevent merger: the point of checks is not harmony among the three powers but forcing them to cooperate while making merger impossible, since union is the beginning of tyranny. The deeper point: constraints on power must rest on structural assumptions, not on assumptions of the rulers' virtue—design institutions for the worst officeholder, not the best.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第十一章第六节 (De l'esprit des lois, XI.6, 1748)；《罗马盛衰原因论》
modes.key_quote_zh: 要防止滥用权力，就必须以权力约束权力——这是一条万古不易的经验。
modes.key_quote_en: To prevent the abuse of power, power must check power—such is the constant lesson of all experience.
process_zh: 权力清点：把政体内实际运行的权力按功能分解为造法、执法、裁判三类，核对名义分类与实际归属的差异
交叉牵制设计：为每一分支配置对其他分支的局部否决、弹劾或解散手段，验证没有任何一支可单独压倒其余
防止合并：检查是否存在使三支权力被同一人或同一派系实际占有的通道（人事任命、紧急状态、宪法修正）
为最坏者设计：删除一切『相信掌权者会自我节制』的制度条款，把约束全部转移到结构与程序上
process_en: Inventory power: decompose the polity's actually operating powers into law-making, law-executing, and judging; compare nominal with actual attribution
Design cross-restraints: give each branch partial veto, impeachment, or dissolution means over the others; verify no branch can singly overwhelm the rest
Prevent merger: audit for channels by which one person or faction could actually possess all three powers (appointments, emergency powers, constitutional amendment)
Design for the worst: delete every clause that trusts officeholders to restrain themselves; shift all restraint onto structure and procedure
representative_cases_zh: 英格兰政体的范例分析：孟德斯鸠误读了英国实践（把法官独立与分权程度估计过高），但他对『王权对议会的否决、议会对王权的弹劾』的功能描述成为分权理论的原始模型
美国1787年宪法：制宪者直接引用第十一章第六节，把分权写进联邦宪法前三条，并以麦迪逊《联邦党人文集》第51篇承续『以野心对抗野心』的推理
法国大革命中的教训：1793年雅各宾专政把立法与行政实际合并于国民公会与救国委员会，正印证了孟德斯鸠『联合即暴政』的预言
反例警示：分权不等于绝对隔离——孟德斯鸠同样强调制衡需要分支间的『必要联系』（行政机关对立法的召集权与否决权），把三权做成互不来往的孤岛只会导致政府瘫痪，而非自由
representative_cases_en: The English constitution as exemplar: Montesquieu misread British practice (overestimating judicial independence and the degree of separation), yet his functional description of royal veto and parliamentary impeachment became the primal model of separation theory

The U.S. Constitution of 1787: the framers cited Book XI.6 directly, wrote separation into the first three articles, and Madison's Federalist No. 51 carried forward the reasoning of 'ambition counteracting ambition'

The French Revolution's lesson: the Jacobin dictatorship of 1793 merged legislation and execution in the National Convention and Committee of Public Safety—confirming Montesquieu's prediction that union is tyranny

Cautionary case: separation is not absolute isolation—Montesquieu equally stressed the 'necessary connections' among branches (the executive's power to convene and veto legislation); three mutually isolated islands yield paralysis, not liberty
modern_applications_zh: 公司治理：把董事会、管理层、监事/审计三线拆分并配置交叉否决（独立董事提名权、审计直通董事会），防止创始人或CEO事实独占三权
软件架构：把定义需求（立法）、实现（行政）、测试与回滚权（司法）分属不同角色，CI 审批权不得与提交权合一
AI 治理：模型训练方、部署方、审计评估方分离，评估机构须有对部署的否决权且不依赖被评估方付费
个人自我管理：给自己的『立法』（目标规则）、『执行』（日程操作）、『审计』（复盘检查）设不同机制与不同触发人，防止自我评价既当运动员又当裁判
modern_applications_en: Corporate governance: split board, management, and audit/supervision into three lines with cross-vetoes (independent-director nomination, audit reporting straight to the board) so a founder or CEO cannot occupy all three powers

Software architecture: assign requirement-setting (legislative), implementation (executive), and test/rollback authority (judicial) to different roles; merge-approval power must not rest with the committer
AI governance: separate model trainers, deployers, and auditors; the evaluator must hold veto power over deployment and must not be paid by the evaluated

Personal self-management: give your own 'legislation' (goal rules), 'execution' (daily operation), and 'audit' (review) different mechanisms and different triggers, so self-assessment is not both player and referee

modes.domain_zh: 按权力归属把政体分为共和、君主、专制三类，并找出各类得以运转的『原则』（动力）
modes.domain_en: Classifying regimes by locus of power into republic, monarchy, and despotism, and identifying the animating 'principle' each requires to function
modes.definition_zh: 孟德斯鸠在《论法的精神》第二至八章建立了政治科学史上第一个系统的政体类型学，并提出了一个原创性问题：政体不仅按其『结构』分类，还须按其『原则』分类——结构是政体的骨架，原则是使骨架运动起来的激情与动力。共和政体（全体或部分人民掌握最高权力）的原则是德性，即公民对平等与祖国的爱；君主政体（单人依固定法律统治）的原则是荣誉，即等级社会中对地位与声望的追求；专制政体（单人依其意志与反复无常统治）的原则是恐惧。方法上有三步：其一，双重诊断——对一个政体既做结构诊断（权力在谁手里、依什么规则运行），又做原则诊断（维系它运转的真实动力是什么，成员日常被什么激情驱动）；其二，原则-结构匹配检验——检查原则与结构是否匹配：共和政体失去德性会堕落为『人人违法而国家照旧』的腐化态，君主政体失去荣誉会滑向专制，专制政体唯一的支撑是恐惧与压服；其三，预诊腐化路径——每种政体有其特定的死亡方式，诊断应预告该政体最可能的腐化方向。这一方法的深意是：制度不会自动运转，任何政体都在不断消耗其原则；政治诊断的核心不是问制度是什么，而是问驱动它的激情还剩多少。
modes.definition_en: In Books II-VIII of The Spirit of the Laws Montesquieu built the first systematic typology in political science and posed an original question: regimes are classified not only by their structure but by their 'principle'—structure is the skeleton, principle the passion that sets it moving. The republic (where the people as a whole or a part holds supreme power) lives on virtue, the love of equality and homeland; monarchy (one man ruling by fixed laws) lives on honor, the pursuit of rank and reputation in a stratified society; despotism (one man ruling by his will and caprice) lives on fear. The method has three steps. First, double diagnosis: examine a regime both structurally (who holds power, by what rules) and by principle (what real动力 sustains it, what passion drives members daily). Second, principle-structure matching: check whether principle fits structure—a republic that loses virtue decays into universal lawbreaking while the state continues; a monarchy that loses honor slides toward despotism; despotism's only support is fear. Third, prediagnose the decay path: each regime has its characteristic manner of death; diagnosis should forecast the direction of its most likely corruption. The deeper point: institutions do not run themselves; every regime consumes its principle—the core of political diagnosis is not what the institution is, but how much of its driving passion remains.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第二至八章 (De l'esprit des lois, II-VIII, 1748)
modes.key_quote_zh: 共和政体需要全部的德性，君主政体需要一种卓越的荣誉，专制政体需要一种可怕的恐惧。
modes.key_quote_en: The republic needs the whole of virtue; monarchy a lofty honor; despotism a terrible fear.
process_zh: 结构诊断：判定最高权力的归属与运行规则，把对象归入共和、君主、专制三类之一
原则诊断：观察成员的日常驱动——他们主要被公共精神、地位竞争还是恐惧所动员，如实记录而非按官方话语记录
匹配检验：检查原则与结构是否相互支撑，识别『结构是共和、动力是恐惧』之类的错配
腐化预诊：按该类型政体的典型堕落路径，列出最先失效的支撑点与最可能的衰变方向
process_en: Structural diagnosis: determine where supreme power lies and by what rules it runs; place the regime among republic, monarchy, or despotism
Principle diagnosis: observe what actually动员 members daily—public spirit, status competition, or fear—recording reality rather than official discourse
Matching test: check whether principle and structure support each other, flagging mismatches such as 'republican structure, fear as the driving passion'
Decay forecast: along the type's characteristic corruption path, list which supports fail first and the likeliest direction of decline
representative_cases_zh: 孟德斯鸠论罗马的衰亡：《罗马盛衰原因论》把罗马共和国的扩张成功归因于德性原则，又把版图扩大导致的公民平等瓦解诊断为共和国死亡的第一因——原则耗尽先于制度崩塌
路易十四后的法国君主政体：等级荣誉体系仍支撑着国王依固定法律统治，但贵族荣誉的空洞化使孟德斯鸠预感到君主政体向专制的滑移——半个世纪后大革命印证
波斯与奥斯曼的专制诊断：他早年《波斯人信札》借东方政体说明『以恐惧为原则的政体结构极简却极脆弱』——统治者一死或一弱，帝国即刻动荡
反例警示：类型学是诊断工具而非道德排序——孟德斯鸠并不认为共和必然优于君主；小国可以养共和之德性，大国往往只能行君主之法度，把类型当价值标签会误读他对『适度』的一贯强调
representative_cases_en: Montesquieu on Rome's fall: Considerations on the Romans attributed the Republic's expansion to the principle of virtue and diagnosed the collapse of civic equality through imperial growth as the first cause of its death—the principle was exhausted before the institutions collapsed

French monarchy after Louis XIV: the hierarchy of honor still sustained rule by fixed laws, but the hollowing of aristocratic honor made Montesquieu foresee monarchy sliding toward despotism—confirmed by the Revolution half a century later

Despotic diagnosis of Persia and the Ottomans: his early Persian Letters used Eastern polities to show that a fear-principled regime is structurally simple yet utterly fragile—on the ruler's death or weakness the empire shakes at once

Cautionary case: the typology is a diagnostic, not a moral ranking—Montesquieu did not hold that republics are simply superior; small states can cultivate republican virtue while large ones can often only practice monarchical law; using types as value labels misreads his constant emphasis on moderation
modern_applications_zh: 组织文化诊断：区分公司章程上的治理结构（共和）与实际驱动（创始人的恐惧管理还是员工的使命认同），文化调查的靶点是『原则』而非『结构』
团队管理：识别一个团队靠什么运转——绩效荣誉、同伴认同还是失业恐惧——并检查激励设计是否与该原则匹配，错配的激励是最常见的组织病
国家比较分析：评级机构与智库对各国做『政体原则』体检（公民参与度、制度信任、恐惧指数），比单看宪法条文更能预测稳定
产品社区运营：判断社区是靠用户荣誉体系、公益共识还是奖惩恐惧维系，原则耗尽的社区会在数据仍健康时突然崩解
modern_applications_en: Organizational culture: distinguish the governance structure on paper (republic) from the actual driving force—founder's fear management or employees' mission; the target of culture audit is 'principle,' not 'structure'

Team management: identify what keeps a team running—performance honor, peer recognition, or fear of dismissal—and check that incentive design matches that principle; mismatched incentives are the commonest organizational disease

Comparative country analysis: rating agencies and think tanks run 'regime-principle' health checks (participation, institutional trust, fear indices) that predict stability better than reading constitutions

Product community operations: judge whether a community lives on user honor systems, shared purpose, or reward-punishment fear; a community whose principle is exhausted collapses suddenly even while metrics look healthy

modes.domain_zh: 把法律还原为它与政体、地理、气候、风俗、贸易、宗教等诸情境的关系总和，反对脱离情境评判法律
modes.domain_en: Reducing law to the sum of its relations with regime, geography, climate, mores, commerce, and religion, refusing to judge laws apart from their situations
modes.definition_zh: 《论法的精神》书名本身就是方法宣言：法的『精神』不在条文的字句里，而在法与诸事物之间的种种关系之中。孟德斯鸠开篇说，从最广泛的意义讲，法是由事物的性质产生出来的必然关系。这把法学从『应然条文之学』改写为『关系之学』：一部法律的好坏，不能脱离它所处的政体、土壤、气候、民族性格、贸易方式与宗教状况来评判，曾在罗马有益的法律搬到巴黎可能荒谬。方法上有三步：其一，关系清点——面对任何一条法律或规则，列出它所处的全部关键关系（与政体、与经济基础、与风俗、与地理气候、与相邻制度）；其二，拟合度评估——检查该规则与其诸情境的相互支撑程度，找出最脆弱的那一重关系；其三，移植预检——任何把规则从一个情境搬到另一个情境的方案，必须逐一回答每一重关系在新情境中是否仍然成立，不成立的关系就是移植失败的预定位点。这一方法的深意是：它是社会科学的整体论先声——制度不是可以单独摘取的果实，而是一张相互支撑的关系网中的一个结点；对制度的科学态度是研究关系，而不是收集条文。
modes.definition_en: The very title The Spirit of the Laws is a methodological declaration: the 'spirit' of law lies not in the words of its clauses but in the relations of law to all the things among which it is determined. Montesquieu opens by saying that laws, in their widest signification, are the necessary relations arising from the nature of things. This rewrites jurisprudence from the study of what ought to be enacted into the study of relations: a law's quality cannot be judged apart from its regime, soil, climate, national character, commerce, and religion—a law wholesome in Rome may be absurd in Paris. The method has three steps. First, inventory the relations: for any law or rule, list all its key relations (with regime, economic base, mores, geography and climate, neighboring institutions). Second, assess fit: examine how well the rule is supported by each of its situations, locating the most fragile relation. Third, pre-check transplantation: any scheme to move a rule from one situation to another must answer, relation by relation, whether each still holds in the new setting; the relations that fail are the predicted points of transplant failure. The deeper point: this is an early announcement of holism in social science—institutions are not fruits to be picked singly but nodes in a web of mutual support; the scientific attitude toward institutions studies relations, not clauses.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第一卷第一章及全书结构 (De l'esprit des lois, I.1, 1748)
modes.key_quote_zh: 从最广泛的意义来说，法是由事物的性质产生出来的必然关系。
modes.key_quote_en: Laws, in their most general signification, are the necessary relations arising from the nature of things.
process_zh: 关系清点：为待分析的法律或制度列出其政体、经济、风俗、地理、宗教、邻接制度六类关键关系
拟合度评估：逐项检查诸关系对该规则的支撑强度，标出最脆弱的一重关系作为失效预定位
移植预检：对每一次规则搬家，逐关系回答『在新情境中是否仍成立』，不成立者即移植失败点
改写条文为关系：把规则文本的分析转换为对『该规则与诸情境相互支撑结构』的分析
process_en: Inventory relations: list the six key relations—regime, economy, mores, geography, religion, adjacent institutions—for the law under analysis
Assess fit: examine the strength of support from each relation, marking the most fragile as the predicted failure point
Pre-check transplantation: for every rule relocation, answer relation by relation whether it still holds in the new setting; failures are transplant breakpoints
Rewrite clauses as relations: convert analysis of rule texts into analysis of the rule's web of mutual support with its situations
representative_cases_zh: 《论法的精神》对罗马土地法的分析：同一部土地法在共和国早期与帝国晚期效果相反，因为支撑它的公民平等与小块土地结构已经消失——条文未变，关系已变
法国贵族继承制的辩护方式：孟德斯鸠不从抽象正义出发，而是论证长子继承制与封建军事义务、领地结构相互支撑——抽掉情境就无从评价
他对奴隶制的双面处理：既以自然法否定奴隶制的正当，又分析其在特定经济结构中『事实存在』的支撑条件——方法上示范了『评价与解释分层』
反例警示：情境主义不等于相对主义——孟德斯鸠反对奴隶制、反对专制、反对宗教迫害的普遍规范立场从未动摇；『法是关系』是解释工具，不是为任何现行恶法开脱的借口
representative_cases_en: His analysis of Roman land laws: the same statute had opposite effects in the early Republic and late Empire because the civic equality and smallholding structure sustaining it had vanished—the text unchanged, the relations changed

His defense of French noble inheritance: he argued not from abstract justice but that primogeniture mutually supported feudal military obligations and estate structure—remove the situation and evaluation is impossible

His double treatment of slavery: he denied slavery's legitimacy from natural law while analyzing the economic conditions of its factual persistence—demonstrating the layering of evaluation and explanation

Cautionary case: situationalism is not relativism—Montesquieu's universal normative positions against slavery, despotism, and religious persecution never wavered; 'law is relations' is an explanatory instrument, not an excuse for any existing bad law
modern_applications_zh: 跨国制度咨询：把任何『某国成功经验』先做六关系清点再谈移植，防止把柏林机场流程抄到雅加达式的失败
企业并购整合：被收购公司的流程规则先做情境清点（原公司的激励、文化、IT底座），逐项评估新情境拟合度后再决定保留或重写
监管沙盒设计：新监管规则先在受控情境试点并记录全部支撑关系，再逐关系评估推广到全市场的可行性
个人习惯迁移：把在旧环境有效的作息/学习规则搬到新环境前，先列出曾支撑它的条件（通勤、室友、健身房位置），缺失的条件就是失败预定位
modern_applications_en: Cross-border institutional consulting: run a six-relation inventory on any 'successful foreign practice' before transplanting, to avoid copying an airport process into a Jakarta that breaks it
M&A integration: inventory the situational supports of the acquired firm's process rules (original incentives, culture, IT substrate); assess fit in the new setting before deciding to keep or rewrite
Regulatory sandbox design: pilot new rules in a controlled setting, record all supporting relations, then evaluate relation by relation the feasibility of market-wide rollout

Personal habit migration: before moving a routine that worked in your old environment, list what supported it (commute, housemates, gym location); the missing supports are the predicted failure points

modes.domain_zh: 把气候、土壤、地形等物理环境作为解释社会制度差异的变量纳入分析，并对其效力设边界
modes.domain_en: Admitting climate, soil, and terrain as variables explaining institutional differences, while bounding their causal force
modes.definition_zh: 《论法的精神》第十四至十八章是社会科学史上第一次把物理环境当作制度变量做系统处理。孟德斯鸠观察到：寒冷空气使人精力充沛、热爱自由与冒险，炎热空气使人倦怠、易受奴役；平原民族倾向于服从与被征服，山地民族热爱自由并善守；岛屿民族更重商业与法律。这些观察今天看来多有谬误，但其方法内核有两点真价值：其一，任何社会解释若只看观念与意志而不看环境约束，是不完整的——人类制度深嵌于物理条件之中；其二，环境变量的效力必须设边界——孟德斯鸠自己明确说过，气候的奴役可以被法律的智慧打破，『人的品德与法律的力量可以对抗气候』，越到晚年他越强调风俗、商业与法律对气候的矫正。方法上有三步：其一，环境清点——为研究对象列出真正起作用的物理约束（资源禀赋、运输成本、流行病压力、气候节律）；其二，机制追踪——追问每个环境变量通过什么具体机制影响制度（是劳动供给、是贸易路线、是军事防御），拒绝把『气候热所以懒惰』这类无机制的断言当作解释；其三，边界校准——估计环境变量的解释力上限，并为『制度能否克服该约束』给出证据化的判断。这一方法的深意是：环境决定论与观念决定论都是偷懒，科学的态度是把环境当作带边界的变量。
modes.definition_en: Books XIV-XVIII of The Spirit of the Laws constitute the first systematic treatment of the physical environment as an institutional variable in social science. Montesquieu observed: cold air invigorates and breeds love of liberty and enterprise; hot air enervates and predisposes to servitude; plains breed submission and conquest, mountains liberty and defense; island peoples incline to commerce and law. Many observations are wrong by today's lights, yet two things of genuine value remain in the method. First, any social explanation that looks only at ideas and will, not at environmental constraint, is incomplete—human institutions are embedded in physical conditions. Second, the causal force of environment must be bounded—Montesquieu himself said the tyranny of climate can be broken by the wisdom of laws, that human virtue and the force of legislation can contend with climate, and in later books he stressed mores, commerce, and law as correctives. The method has three steps. First, inventory the environment: list the physical constraints that genuinely operate (resource endowment, transport costs, epidemiological pressure, climatic rhythm). Second, trace mechanisms: ask by what concrete mechanism each variable shapes institutions (labor supply, trade routes, military defense), refusing unmechanized claims like 'hot climate, therefore lazy.' Third, calibrate bounds: estimate the explanatory ceiling of environmental variables and give an evidence-based judgment on whether institutions can overcome the constraint. The deeper point: environmental determinism and ideational determinism are equally lazy; the scientific attitude treats environment as a bounded variable.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第十四至十八章 (De l'esprit des lois, XIV-XVIII, 1748)；《波斯人信札》的环境观察
modes.key_quote_zh: 人的品德与法律的力量可以对抗气候——环境的奴役是可以被打破的。
modes.key_quote_en: Human virtue and the force of laws can contend with climate—the tyranny of environment can be broken.
process_zh: 环境清点：列出研究对象真实承受的物理约束——资源、运输、疾病、气候节律、地形防御
机制追踪：为每个环境变量写出从物理条件到制度的传导链条，无机制的断言不得进入解释
边界校准：估计该变量的解释力上限，识别哪些差异必须由制度与观念变量接手解释
矫正检验：评估既有制度对该约束的克服程度，并为『进一步制度改造能否突破约束』寻找证据
process_en: Inventory the environment: list the physical constraints genuinely borne—resources, transport, disease, climatic rhythm, terrain defense
Trace mechanisms: write out the chain from physical condition to institution for each variable; claims without mechanisms may not enter the explanation
Calibrate bounds: estimate each variable's explanatory ceiling and identify which differences must be explained by institutional and ideational variables instead
Test correctives: assess how far existing institutions already overcome the constraint, and seek evidence on whether further institutional reform can break it
representative_cases_zh: 他对『南方奴役、北方自由』的原始表述：他把欧洲南部的专制倾向部分归因于气候，但同书随即论证中国的制度严酷不能全部归于气候、印度的宗教更胜于气候塑造社会——他自己就在给变量设界
《论法的精神》论岛屿与商业：岛屿民族因海洋运输成本低而重商重法，这一『地理-贸易-法律』链条机制清晰，成为后来贸易政治学的先声
孟德斯鸠对平政体与山地政体的军事社会学：平原易征服故尚服从、山地难征服故尚自由——机制（防御成本）明确，比同类断言更接近社会科学
反例警示：气候章节是全书被后世证伪最多的部分——『炎热使人懒惰』在热带经济史研究面前站不住；使用本方法时必须把原始气候论当作已被推翻的初始假说，只保留『环境作为带机制的带边界变量』这一内核
representative_cases_en: His original 'servitude in the south, liberty in the north' claim: he partly attributed southern despotism to climate, yet in the same work argued China's institutional severity cannot all be charged to climate and that religion shapes India more than weather—he was himself bounding the variable

Islands and commerce: island peoples weigh commerce and law heavily because maritime transport is cheap; this 'geography-trade-law' chain is mechanistically clear and anticipates later trade political economy

His military sociology of plains and mountains: plains are easily conquered and breed submission, mountains hard to conquer breed liberty—the mechanism (defense cost) is explicit and closer to social science than sibling claims

Cautionary case: the climate chapters are the most refuted part of the book—'heat makes men lazy' cannot stand against tropical economic history; users must treat the original climate theory as an overturned initial hypothesis, keeping only the core of 'environment as a bounded variable with mechanisms'
modern_applications_zh: 区位与产业分析：评估区域经济时先列运输成本、资源禀赋、气候灾害等物理约束并追踪机制，再评估制度变量，避免纯『营商环境』叙事
供应链韧性设计：把地理风险（单一海运通道、气候灾害带）作为常设变量纳入供应链建模，并为每条约束设计制度性对冲
历史解释审查：读到『某民族性源于地理』类断言时，强制追问机制与边界，识别环境决定论的偷懒
个人迁移决策：把气候、通勤、居住成本等物理变量纳入职业/城市选择，同时明确它们不是决定项——机制可控的约束不构成否决理由
modern_applications_en: Location and industry analysis: when assessing regional economies, first list physical constraints (transport costs, endowments, climate hazards) and trace mechanisms, then weigh institutional variables—avoiding pure 'business-climate' narratives
Supply-chain resilience: model geographic risks (single sea lanes, hazard belts) as standing variables and design institutional hedges for each constraint
Auditing historical explanations: on reading 'a nation's character derives from its geography,' force the questions of mechanism and bounds, spotting environmental determinism's shortcuts

Personal relocation decisions: include climate, commuting, and cost of living as physical variables in career or city choice, while refusing to let them decide—constraints with controllable mechanisms are not veto reasons
representative_figures: 孟德斯鸠的同时代人：布丰
现代对话者：贾雷德·戴蒙德

modes.domain_zh: 把自由定义为『做法律所许可的一切事情的权利』，先立边界再谈自由，拒绝把自由混同于任意妄为
modes.domain_en: Defining liberty as 'the right to do whatever the laws permit'—setting boundaries before celebrating freedom, refusing to conflate liberty with doing as one pleases
modes.definition_zh: 孟德斯鸠对『自由』做了启蒙时代最重要的概念澄清。流行的误解把自由理解为不受一切限制、想做什么就做什么；孟德斯鸠在第十一章第三节反驳：自由是做法律所许可的一切事情的权利；如果一个公民能够做法律所禁止的事情，他就不再有自由了，因为他人也同样有这种权利。他又区分：政治自由是一种心境的平静状态，来自人人都感到安全——这与民主制、专制制之间没有必然绑定，自由只在权力不被滥用的温和政体中存在，而且『多数人的暴政』并不比一人专断更少威胁。方法上有三步：其一，概念澄清——区分『自由』『任意』『无政府』三个概念，检查讨论中的『自由』实际指哪一个；其二，边界定义——把自由定义为可预期的法律边界内的行动空间，先明确边界，再度量边界内的自由宽度；其三，安全本位检验——评估一项自由状态时，不问『能做多少事』而问『行动者是否对自身与财产有稳定的安全预期』，因为自由的心境本质是安全。这一方法的深意是：自由与法治不是对立物，法是自由的边界装置而非自由的敌人——没有边界预期的『自由』只是强者支配弱者的丛林状态。
modes.definition_en: Montesquieu made the Enlightenment's most important conceptual clarification of 'liberty.' Against the popular understanding of freedom as absence of all restraint, he replies in Book XI.3: liberty is the right of doing whatever the laws permit; if a citizen could do what the laws forbid, he would no longer possess liberty, because others would possess the same right. He further distinguishes: political liberty is a tranquility of mind arising from the opinion each has of his safety—and it is not tied to democracy; it exists only in moderate governments where power is not abused, and the tyranny of the many is no less menacing than the caprice of one. The method has three steps. First, conceptual clarification: distinguish liberty, caprice, and anarchy, and identify which of the three a discussion's 'freedom' actually denotes. Second, boundary definition: define liberty as action space within predictable legal boundaries—fix the boundary first, then measure the liberty inside it. Third, the security test: when assessing a state of freedom, ask not 'how much can be done' but 'do actors hold a stable expectation of safety for person and property,' since the mental essence of liberty is security. The deeper point: liberty and the rule of law are not opposites—law is liberty's boundary device, not its enemy; 'freedom' without predictable boundaries is merely the jungle where the strong支配 the weak.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第十一章第三、四、六节 (De l'esprit des lois, XI.3-4, 6, 1748)
modes.key_quote_zh: 自由是做法律所许可的一切事情的权利；如果一个公民能够做法律所禁止的事情，他就不再自由了。
modes.key_quote_en: Liberty is the right of doing whatever the laws permit; if a citizen could do what they forbid, he would no longer be free.
process_zh: 概念澄清：把讨论中的『自由』逐一归入真自由（边界内的权利）、任意（无公共边界）或无政府（无执行边界），避免概念滑动
边界定义：先写清适用边界——谁受什么规则约束、边界由何种程序设定与修改，再度量边界内的行动宽度
安全本位检验：用『行动者对人身、财产与程序是否有稳定安全预期』作为自由的度量，而非用许可数量度量
多数风险检查：评估边界设定者本身是否受约束，防止『民主多数』成为不受限的新主人
process_en: Clarify the concept: sort each use of 'freedom' into true liberty (rights within boundaries), caprice (no public boundary), or anarchy (no enforced boundary), stopping conceptual slippage
Define boundaries: write down who is bound by what rules and by what procedure the boundary is set and revised, before measuring the width of action inside it
Apply the security test: measure liberty by whether actors hold stable expectations of safety for person, property, and procedure—not by counting permissions
Check the majority risk: audit whether the boundary-setters themselves are restrained, so a democratic majority cannot become the new unbounded master
representative_cases_zh: 第十一章第三节的定义之争：孟德斯鸠直接反驳霍布斯把自由定义为『无阻碍』的做法——若自由是无阻碍，则被剥夺法律保护的臣民最『自由』，这显然荒谬
英格兰的自由与安全：他选英格兰做范例，不因英国人许可最多，而因英国公民对『明天不会被逮捕』有最强预期——自由的心境是安全
他对古代共和国的警告：斯巴达式的『公民美德自由』把个人完全吞没于城邦，个人在公共事务外毫无空间——集体许可再多也不是政治自由
反例警示：边界定义不等于为过度管制辩护——孟德斯鸠同时要求边界本身必须温和、稳定、依正当程序设定；以『安全』为名扩张边界恰恰侵蚀自由所依赖的安全预期
representative_cases_en: The definitional dispute of XI.3: Montesquieu directly rebuts Hobbes's definition of liberty as absence of impediments—if liberty were that, the subject stripped of legal protection would be most 'free,' which is plainly absurd

English liberty as security: he chose England as exemplar not because the English were permitted the most but because citizens held the strongest expectation of not being arrested tomorrow—the mind of liberty is security

His warning about ancient republics: Spartan 'civic-virtue freedom' swallowed the individual into the polis, leaving no space outside public affairs—no quantity of collective permission yields political liberty

Cautionary case: boundary definition does not license overregulation—Montesquieu equally demanded that boundaries be moderate, stable, and set by due process; expanding boundaries in the name of 'safety' corrodes the very safety expectations liberty depends on
modern_applications_zh: 平台规则设计：社区自由先写边界（禁止行为清单与申诉程序）再开放，规则频繁无程序变更会摧毁用户的『安全预期』比规则严更致命
组织授权体系：给团队授权先定义决策边界（预算线、否决条款、越界后果），授权宽度以边界可预期为前提
公共讨论质检：在网络争论中识别『自由』的三种混用（许可、任意、无序），把争点从口号拉回边界程序
个人自律模型：把自律理解为给自己设定的稳定边界而非许可清单——边界稳定带来的可预期性才是效率来源
modern_applications_en: Platform rule design: open a community only after writing its boundaries (forbidden lists and appeal procedures); boundary changes without procedure destroy users' safety expectations more lethally than strictness
Organizational delegation: define decision boundaries (budget lines, veto clauses, breach consequences) before granting autonomy; delegation width presupposes predictable boundaries
Public-discourse quality control: in online arguments detect the three conflations of 'freedom' (permission, caprice, disorder) and pull the dispute from slogans back to boundary procedures
Personal self-discipline: understand self-discipline as stable self-set boundaries, not permission lists—the predictability of stable boundaries is what produces efficiency

modes.domain_zh: 把『温和』（moderation）作为制度设计与人行动的最高标准，在极端之间为制度寻找可行区间
modes.domain_en: Taking moderation as the supreme standard of institutional design and action, seeking the feasible interval for institutions between extremes
modes.definition_zh: 贯穿孟德斯鸠全部著作的一个词是『温和』。他在《论法的精神》中称温和是立法者的首要德性，并反复论证：一切极端的政体安排、极端的法律制裁、极端的社会实验都会自毁——严刑峻法使人心变硬反而增加犯罪，极端平等摧毁共和政体自身，极端的剥夺制造反抗。他对『中庸』的辩护不是美学偏好而是机制分析：法律的功能是改变风俗，而风俗的改变需要时间与可预期性，跳过渐进过程的激进立法会遭遇风俗的反弹，效果与意图相反。方法上有三步：其一，极化识别——为任何制度变革或强力行动画出极端谱系的两个端点（全放任/全管制、全废除/全保留），检查当前方案是否正滑向某一端；其二，可行区间测定——用机制的-resistant points（风俗阻力、执行能力、反馈时滞）划出改革真正可行的区间，方案必须落在区间内；其三，分步节奏设计——把落在区间内的方案拆成可逆的分步试验，每步观察风俗与执行反馈后再走下一步。这一方法的深意是：政治与制度工程的首要失败模式不是方向错误，而是剂量错误——正确的方向配以过量的剂量，结果与错误方向相同。
modes.definition_en: The word running through all Montesquieu's work is moderation. In The Spirit of the Laws he calls moderation the foremost virtue of the legislator and argues throughout that every extreme—of constitutional arrangement, legal punishment, or social experiment—destroys itself: savage punishments harden hearts and multiply crime; extreme equality dissolves the republic; extreme expropriation breeds resistance. His defense of the mean is not aesthetic preference but mechanism: law works by changing mores, and mores change only through time and predictability; radical legislation that skips the gradual path meets the recoil of mores and produces the opposite of intent. The method has three steps. First, polar identification: draw the two endpoints of the extreme spectrum for any reform or forceful action ( laissez-faire/full control, abolish/preserve entirely) and check whether the current scheme is sliding toward one pole. Second, feasible-interval measurement: use the mechanism's resistant points—moral inertia, executive capacity, feedback lag—to delimit the interval within which reform can actually run; the scheme must land inside it. Third, stepped-rhythm design: break the in-interval scheme into reversible staged trials, advancing only after observing mores and execution feedback at each step. The deeper point: the primary failure mode of politics and institutional engineering is not wrong direction but wrong dosage—the right direction with an overdose yields the same result as the wrong direction.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第六章、第二十九章 (De l'esprit des lois, VI, XXIX, 1748)；《罗马盛衰原因论》
modes.key_quote_zh: 温和是立法者的首要德性——我说的温和，是免除极端。
modes.key_quote_en: Moderation is the first virtue of the legislator—by which I mean the exclusion of extremes.
process_zh: 极化识别：为议题画出两端极端谱系，检查当前方案与言辞是否在向一端极化
阻力清点：列出该议题上风俗、既得利益、执行能力、反馈时滞四类阻力点及其强度
区间测定：以阻力点为约束求出改革可行区间，废弃一切落在区间外的『纸面最优』方案
分步节奏：把方案拆为可逆分步试验，每步以风俗与执行反馈为闸门，拒绝一次性跃迁
process_en: Identify polarization: draw the spectrum's two extremes for the issue and check whether the current scheme and its rhetoric are polarizing toward one end
Inventory resistance: list the four classes of resistant points—moral inertia, vested interests, executive capacity, feedback lag—and their strength
Measure the interval: derive the feasible reform interval from the resistance constraints, discarding all 'paper-optimal' schemes outside it
Set stepped rhythm: split the scheme into reversible staged trials gated by mores and execution feedback, refusing the one-shot leap
representative_cases_zh: 刑罚章节的实证论证：孟德斯鸠以各国经验论证严刑使民风硬化、温和而必然的刑罚更能 deter——这是现代刑罚经济学的先声，比贝卡里亚早四十年
《罗马盛衰原因论》中的格拉古兄弟：土地改革方向正确（纠正兼并），但一次性强推越过风俗与利益阻力区间，引发百年内战——方向对、剂量错的经典标本
他对法国贵族制的渐进立场：不主张废除贵族制而主张把它改造为与君主法律相容的中间团体——中间团体作为权力的缓冲层，是他留给后世的制度发明
反例警示：温和不等于不作为或乡愿——孟德斯鸠明确支持在风俗已备时果断废除奴隶制与宗教迫害；温和是对剂量的纪律，不是对正义的稀释，当极端本身是现状时，温和恰恰要求消灭它
representative_cases_en: His empirical argument on punishment: using cross-national experience he showed savage laws harden mores while mild and inevitable penalties deter better—an anticipation of the economics of crime forty years before Beccaria

The Gracchi in Considerations: their land reform had the right direction (correcting concentration) but a one-shot push across the interval of mores and interests triggered a century of civil war—the classic specimen of right direction, wrong dosage

His gradualist position on the French nobility: not abolition but transformation into intermediate bodies compatible with monarchical law—intermediate bodies as power's buffer layer were his institutional invention for posterity

Cautionary case: moderation is not inaction or fence-sitting—he explicitly urged resolute abolition of slavery and religious persecution where mores were ready; moderation is discipline over dosage, not dilution of justice, and when the extreme is the status quo, moderation demands ending it
modern_applications_zh: 变革管理：任何组织变革先画极端谱系、测阻力区间，再设计分步可逆节奏——用『剂量审计』替代『方向辩论』
货币政策与宏观调控：把渐进主义作为默认框架，一次性冲击只在反馈通道完整且可逆时使用
产品灰度发布：新功能全量推送前先测风俗阻力（用户习惯、客服压力），按区间分步放量
个人自我改造：戒断类目标用剂量递减与情境改造替代一次性宣战，把复发数据当作区间校准信号而非意志失败
modern_applications_en: Change management: for any reform, first draw the spectrum and measure the resistance interval, then design reversible staged rhythm—replace the 'direction debate' with a 'dosage audit'
Monetary policy and macro-management: make gradualism the default framework; one-shot shocks only where feedback channels are complete and reversible
Product gray release: before full rollout, measure user-habit and support-load resistance; scale in steps along the interval
Personal habit change: replace the one-shot declaration of war with dose reduction and context redesign; treat relapse data as interval-calibration signals, not failures of will

modes.domain_zh: 分析商业如何通过利益计算习惯塑造温和风俗、削弱暴力与迷信，并设计以贸易替代征服的秩序
modes.domain_en: Analyzing how commerce shapes mild mores through habits of exact calculation, weakening violence and superstition, and designing order that substitutes trade for conquest
modes.definition_zh: 《论法的精神》第二十章提出了一个影响深远的命题：商业的自然效果是带来和平——互相交易的两个民族会彼此依存，而『商业的日常效果是摧毁某些偏见』。孟德斯鸠观察到：从事商业的人习惯于精确计算、长期履约与对等交换，这种心智习惯外溢为温和的风俗；商业社会的人们务实、精确、守约、厌恶抢劫式获取；而纯农业或掠夺型社会则更容易被迷信与暴力支配。方法上有三步：其一，交换习惯盘点——识别一个社会（组织、群体）的主导交往模式是掠夺、馈赠还是对等交换，并观察该模式对风俗的塑形方向；其二，商业机制设计——在需要降低冲突的场合，设计使对方利益与本方利益挂钩的长期交易结构（重复博弈、抵押、声誉），让『计算』替代『激情』成为主导心理；其三，商业风险对冲——同时监控商业带来的反作用：财富集中、唯利是图对公共德性的侵蚀，孟德斯鸠本人明确警告商业精神会产生『极端的吝啬与不义』，需要政治制度与风俗对冲。这一方法的深意是：和平不靠善意宣告，而靠把暴力从计算中排除掉——当合作比掠夺更划算成为共同预期，风俗随之温和。
modes.definition_en: Book XX of The Spirit of the Laws advances a far-reaching proposition: the natural effect of commerce is to lead to peace—two nations that trade together become mutually dependent, and 'the natural effect of commerce is to bring about a revulsion from destructive prejudices.' Montesquieu observed: people of commerce grow habituated to exact calculation, long-term performance, and equivalent exchange, and this mental habit spills over into mild mores; commercial peoples are practical, precise, punctual, and averse to rapacious acquisition, while purely agrarian or predatorial societies are more easily governed by superstition and violence. The method has three steps. First, inventory exchange habits: identify whether a society's (or organization's, or group's) dominant mode of interaction is predation, gift, or equivalent exchange, and note which way that mode shapes mores. Second, design commercial mechanisms: where conflict must be lowered, build long-term exchange structures linking the other side's interest to one's own (repeated games, collateral, reputation), letting calculation displace passion as the governing psychology. Third, hedge commerce's risks: simultaneously monitor commerce's counter-effects—wealth concentration and profit-worship eroding public virtue; Montesquieu himself warned that the spirit of commerce produces 'extreme parsimony and injustice,' requiring political institutions and mores as hedges. The deeper point: peace rests not on declarations of goodwill but on excluding violence from calculation—when 'cooperation beats plunder' becomes the shared expectation, mores soften accordingly.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第二十章 (De l'esprit des lois, XX, 1748)；《波斯人信札》中的商业观察
modes.key_quote_zh: 商业的自然效果是带来和平；互相交易的两个民族会变得彼此依存。
modes.key_quote_en: The natural effect of commerce is to lead to peace: two nations that trade together become mutually dependent.
process_zh: 交换模式盘点：判定对象群体的主导交往形态（掠夺/馈赠/对等交换）及其对风俗的塑形方向
利益挂钩设计：在冲突点上构造长期重复交易结构——重复博弈、抵押品、声誉记录，使合作成为占优策略
计算心智培育：用精确的结算、履约与对等交换习惯替代以激情与身份为本的争斗心理
德性对冲监控：同步监控财富集中与唯利风气对公共德性的侵蚀，预设政治与风俗对冲机制
process_en: Inventory exchange modes: judge the group's dominant interaction form (predation, gift, equivalent exchange) and the direction it shapes mores
Design interest linkage: at conflict points construct long-term repeatable exchange—repeated games, collateral, reputation records—making cooperation the dominant strategy
Cultivate the calculating mind: replace passion- and identity-driven strife with habits of exact settlement, performance, and equivalent exchange
Monitor the virtue hedge: simultaneously track wealth concentration and profit-worship eroding public virtue, with political and moral hedges preset
representative_cases_zh: 哥特人停止掠夺罗马的案例解释：孟德斯鸠以商业利益解释蛮族从劫掠转向定居统治——掠取一次的收益低于长期税收，计算改变了征服者本身
他对犹太人中世纪放贷处境的分析：商业职能在贵族社会中的低地位与宗教迫害相互强化，说明『商业地位』与『风俗温和』互为因果
荷兰共和国的范式：他把联省共和国当作商业精神塑造政治温和（宗教宽容、有限政府）的活标本——商业精英需要可预期的法律而非任意权力
反例警示：商业不自动产生和平——孟德斯鸠同时记录了东印度公司的贸易暴行；当贸易以垄断特许与武力护航进行时，计算指向掠夺而非交换；『doux commerce』生效的前提是对等竞争的开放市场
representative_cases_en: His account of the Goths ceasing to plunder Rome: he explained by commercial interest the barbarians' turn from raiding to settled rule—the yield of one plunder is below long-term taxation; calculation changed the conquerors themselves

His analysis of medieval Jewish moneylending: the low status of commerce in aristocratic society and religious persecution mutually reinforced each other—commercial standing and mild mores are jointly causal

The Dutch Republic as paradigm: he treated the United Provinces as the living specimen of commercial spirit producing political mildness—religious toleration, limited government—because commercial elites need predictable law, not arbitrary power

Cautionary case: commerce does not automatically produce peace—he also recorded the trading atrocities of the East India companies; where trade runs on monopoly charters and armed convoys, calculation points to plunder, not exchange; doux commerce presupposes open markets of equivalent competition
modern_applications_zh: 国际贸易政策：把『相互依存降低冲突』作为政策评估变量，同时审计依存的对称性——不对称依存反而成为胁迫工具
平台生态治理：让平台与第三方服务商形成长期利益挂钩（分成、抵押、声誉分），以交易结构替代强制管控
社区冲突调解：在对抗群体间先搭建小额可重复的合作交易（联合项目、互惠清单），用成功交易积累替代信任喊话
个人职业网络：把人脉从『求人办事』改造为长期对等交换（持续互相输送价值），声誉记录是最强的合作黏合剂
modern_applications_en: International trade policy: treat 'interdependence lowers conflict' as a policy-evaluation variable while auditing its symmetry—asymmetric dependence becomes a coercive instrument

Platform ecosystem governance: bind third-party providers to the platform with long-term interest linkage (revenue shares, collateral, reputation scores), substituting exchange structure for command control

Community conflict mediation: first build small repeatable cooperative trades between hostile groups (joint projects, reciprocity lists), accumulating successful transactions in place of trust appeals
Personal professional networks: convert networks from 'asking favors' to long-term equivalent exchange (continuously shipping value both ways); a reputation record is the strongest binding agent

modes.domain_zh: 跨时代、跨政体地比较制度成败，从大量历史案例中归纳政体兴衰的规律而非从单一案例外推
modes.domain_en: Comparing institutional successes and failures across eras and regimes, inducing laws of rise and decline from many historical cases rather than extrapolating from one
modes.definition_zh: 孟德斯鸠的方法论底色是把历史当作制度实验室。他阅读广博——罗马史、日耳曼法、封建制度、各国政制——但从不满足于讲故事：他从《罗马盛衰原因论》开始就在做受控式的比较——同一变量（公民平等、土地分配、军事组织）在不同历史条件下取值不同，观察结果如何随之变化。《论法的精神》更以数百个跨文明案例支撑其类型学。方法上有三步：其一，变量抽取——从历史案例中抽出可比较的变量（税制、继承制、军队组织、宗教组织方式），拒绝以『民族性』这类不可操作的笼统标签替代变量；其二，多案例配对比较——为每个候选规律寻找正反案例：同一变量在不同情境的取值组合与结果差异，规律的成立以『反例可解释』为条件；其三，规律分级——区分普遍规律（凡政体皆然）、类型规律（某类政体下成立）与情境规律（特定条件下成立），并为每条规律标注其适用层级。这一方法的深意是：它是社会科学比较方法的直接源头——托克维尔、韦伯的比较历史社会学都运行在孟德斯鸠铺下的轨道上；历史不是道德故事的仓库，而是提供变量变异的数据源。
modes.definition_en: Montesquieu's methodological ground was to treat history as an institutional laboratory. He read vastiy—Roman history, Germanic law, feudal institutions, the constitutions of many nations—but never contented himself with storytelling: from Considerations on the Romans onward he practiced a quasi-controlled comparison—the same variable (civic equality, land distribution, military organization) taking different values under different historical conditions, and outcomes observed accordingly. The Spirit of the Laws supports its typology with hundreds of cross-civilizational cases. The method has three steps. First, extract variables: from historical cases draw comparable variables (taxation, inheritance, military organization, religious organization), refusing unoperational labels like 'national character' as substitutes for variables. Second, paired multi-case comparison: for each candidate law seek confirming and disconfirming cases—combinations of variable values across situations and the resulting differences; a law stands only if its counterexamples can be explained. Third, grade the law: distinguish universal laws (true of all regimes), type-laws (true of a class of regimes), and situational laws (true under specific conditions), tagging each law with its level of application. The deeper point: this is the direct source of the comparative method in social science—Tocqueville's and Weber's comparative-historical sociology run on rails Montesquieu laid; history is not a warehouse of moral tales but a data source supplying variation in variables.
modes.source_chapter: 《罗马盛衰原因论》(Considérations sur les causes de la grandeur des Romains et de leur décadence, 1734)；《论法的精神》全书案例结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不是在写颂歌或讽刺文，我是在寻找原因——支配世界的不是命运，而是原因。
modes.key_quote_en: I am not writing panegyrics or satires: I seek causes—it is not fortune that rules the world, but causes.
process_zh: 变量抽取：把待解释的兴衰现象拆为可跨案例比较的变量，替换一切『民族性』式笼统标签
正反配对：为每条候选规律同时找支持案例与反例案例，反例不可解释者规律作废
规律分级：把结论标注为普遍规律、类型规律或情境规律，禁止跨级引用
情境复核：引用任何历史先例前，核对先例的变量取值与当前情境的取值是否真正同构
process_en: Extract variables: decompose the rise-decline phenomenon to be explained into variables comparable across cases, replacing all 'national character' labels
Pair confirming and disconfirming cases: for each candidate law find both supporting and counter cases; unexplainable counterexamples void the law
Grade the law: tag conclusions as universal, type-level, or situational, and forbid cross-level citation
Re-verify the situation: before citing any historical precedent, check whether the precedent's variable values are truly isomorphic to the present case
representative_cases_zh: 《罗马盛衰原因论》的方法自觉：他明确声明『不是罗马人的德性或恶行有变化，而是公民平等发生了变化』——把罗马兴衰从道德叙事改写为变量分析，开比较方法之先河
对『宽和政体优于专制』的论证：他不是从哲学原则推演，而是汇总了欧洲、亚洲、古代、近代的多组政体成败案例做归纳，并以反例（成功的东方专制）修正边界条件
日耳曼法的比较研究：他把封建制度追溯到日耳曼人的征服习惯，通过比较法兰克、伦巴第、哥特各支法律的同异重建制度演化树——比较法的开端
反例警示：比较历史易被『选样偏差』污染——孟德斯鸠对中国政制的评价前后矛盾（有时盛赞其德性有时斥其专制），因为他依赖的是传教士二手报告；二手资料的变量失真是比较法最深的坑
representative_cases_en: The methodological self-awareness of Considerations: he declares that it was not Roman virtue or vice that changed but civic equality—rewriting Rome's rise and fall from moral narrative into variable analysis, inaugurating the comparative method

Arguing moderate government beats despotism: not deduced from philosophical principle but induced from multiple sets of regime successes and failures across Europe, Asia, antiquity and modernity, with boundary conditions corrected by counterexamples (successful Eastern despotisms)

Comparative study of Germanic law: tracing feudal institutions to Germanic conquest customs, reconstructing the institutional tree by comparing Frankish, Lombard, and Gothic laws—the beginning of comparative law

Cautionary case: comparative history is easily polluted by selection bias—Montesquieu's judgments on Chinese institutions contradict themselves (praising virtue here, damning despotism there) because he relied on missionary secondhand reports; variable distortion in sources is the deepest pit of the method
modern_applications_zh: 行业兴衰研究：把『某行业为何衰落』拆为可跨公司、跨国比较的变量（成本结构、监管暴露、技术依赖），禁止用『企业文化』一笔带过
投资尽调：对『历史上每次加息都导致…』类规律，强制寻找正反案例并标注规律层级（普遍/类型/情境）
管理实践移植：引入标杆企业的做法前，先核对自身与标杆在关键变量上的取值是否同构，禁止按头条叙事照搬
历史类比质检：公共讨论中『这像极了1937』类类比，用变量同构检验替代情绪共鸣
modern_applications_en: Industry-decline research: decompose 'why an industry declined' into variables comparable across firms and countries (cost structure, regulatory exposure, technology dependence), never waving it away as 'corporate culture'
Investment due diligence: for laws like 'every rate hike has led to…', force the search for confirming and disconfirming cases and tag the law's level (universal/type/situational)
Management-practice transplantation: before importing a benchmark firm's practice, verify isomorphism on key variables; prohibit copying by headline narrative
Historical-analogy quality control: in public debate, test 'this is just like 1937' claims by variable isomorphism, not emotional resonance

modes.domain_zh: 识别权力走向专制的结构信号——恐惧原则抬头、中间权力被拆除、法律失去可预期性——在不可逆前发出预警
modes.domain_en: Detecting the structural signals of sliding into despotism—rising fear, dismantled intermediate powers, loss of legal predictability—before the slide becomes irreversible
modes.definition_zh: 孟德斯鸠对专制的分析不是道德檄文而是机制解剖。他指出专制政体结构上『极简』：不需要法律、不需要等级、不需要荣誉，只需要恐惧与压服；也正因极简，它最脆弱且最易传染——当一个温和政体开始拆除自己的『中间权力』（贵族、教会、法庭、行会、地方自治这些横亘在君主与个人之间的缓冲结构），把一切权力通道直接通向中央，专制的技术条件就齐备了。他断言专制的特性是：统治者可以轻易地、瞬间地做出巨大变革，因为无人有任何可以据以抵抗的固定物。方法上有三步：其一，中间权力清点——列出政体（组织）内全部缓冲结构及其对最高权力的实际牵制能力，追踪其被削弱的事件序列；其二，恐惧指标监测——测量成员行为的驱动是否从规则与荣誉转向对惩罚的预期（自我审查、举报、规避），恐惧抬头是原则替换的最灵敏信号；其三，法律可预期性审计——检查规则是否仍稳定、公开、对掌权者自身适用；『法律对强者失效』是专制成立的技术标志。这一方法的深意是：专制不是一夜政变，而是一个可监测的渐进过程——中间权力的拆除先行，恐惧继之，最后才是法律失效；预警的价值就在于前两步仍可逆。
modes.definition_en: Montesquieu's analysis of despotism is a mechanical dissection, not a moral denunciation. Despotism, he shows, is structurally 'simple': it needs no laws, no ranks, no honor, only fear and crushing; and precisely because simple, it is most fragile and most contagious—when a moderate regime begins dismantling its own 'intermediate powers' (nobility, church, courts, guilds, local self-rule—the buffers standing between ruler and individual), channeling every path of power straight to the center, the technical conditions of despotism are complete. He asserts the character of despotism: the ruler can make immense changes easily and in an instant, because no one possesses anything fixed to resist with. The method has three steps. First, intermediate-power inventory: list every buffer structure in the polity (or organization) and its actual restraining capacity over the supreme power, tracking the sequence of their weakening. Second, fear-index monitoring: measure whether members' conduct is shifting from rules and honor toward expectation of punishment (self-censorship, denunciation, evasion); rising fear is the most sensitive signal of principle replacement. Third, audit legal predictability: check whether rules remain stable, public, and applicable to the powerful themselves; 'law failing against the strong' is the technical marker of despotism established. The deeper point: despotism is not an overnight coup but a monitorable gradual process—intermediate powers go first, fear follows, legal失效 comes last; the warning's value lies in the reversibility of the first two stages.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第二至八章、第十一章 (De l'esprit des lois, II-VIII, XI, 1748)；《波斯人信札》的专制心理学
modes.key_quote_zh: 专制的特性是：统治者可以轻易地、瞬间地做出巨大的变革——因为在这类政体里，无人拥有任何可以据以抵抗的固定物。
modes.key_quote_en: The characteristic of despotism: the ruler can make immense changes easily and in an instant—for in such a state no one possesses anything fixed to resist with.
process_zh: 中间权力清点：列出全部横亘在最高权力与个人之间的缓冲结构（法庭、行会、地方自治、专业团体）及其牵制能力
削弱事件追踪：为每个缓冲结构记录被削弱或被绕开的事件序列，形成时间线
恐惧指标监测：测量自我审查、举报增加、规避行为等恐惧信号，与规则与荣誉驱动做对比
可预期性审计：检查规则对掌权者自身是否仍然适用，失效即为最高级警报
process_en: Intermediate-power inventory: list every buffer between supreme power and the individual (courts, guilds, local self-rule, professional bodies) and its restraining capacity
Weakening-event tracking: for each buffer, log the sequence of events weakening or bypassing it, forming a timeline
Fear-index monitoring: measure signals of self-censorship, rising denunciation, and evasion against the baseline of rule- and honor-driven conduct
Predictability audit: check whether rules still bind the powerful themselves; their failure is the highest-level alarm
representative_cases_zh: 他对法国『穿袍贵族』与高等法院的辩护：高等法院的注册权是王权的日常牵制，他本人作为波尔多高等法院院长亲历路易十五对法院的压制——中间权力的拆除在他生前已开始
《波斯人信札》的专制心理学：通过郁斯贝克的后宫寓言展示恐惧原则的自我消耗——监视者本人也被监视，恐惧体系内部的信任成本吞噬其运转能力
对罗马帝政的分析：《罗马盛衰原因论》把帝政取代共和国的转折点定在中间阶层（元老院与行省自治）被皇帝家臣体系取代之时
反例警示：中间权力不必然是自由的堡垒——孟德斯鸠清楚贵族中间权力同样可以是压迫性特权；他对中间权力的辩护以『该结构本身温和』为条件，不能把本方法的清点对象误当作价值上无可怀疑的护自由同盟
representative_cases_en: His defense of the robe nobility and parlements: the parlements' registration right was a daily check on royal power; as president of the Bordeaux parlement he lived through Louis XV's repression of the courts—the dismantling began in his lifetime

The despotism psychology of Persian Letters: through Usbek's harem he displays fear-principle self-exhaustion—the watcher is himself watched; trust costs inside a fear system devour its operating capacity

His analysis of the Roman Empire: in Considerations he dates the fatal turn from republic to empire to the replacement of intermediate bodies (senate, provincial self-rule) by the emperor's household agents

Cautionary case: intermediate powers are not automatically bulwarks of freedom—he knew noble intermediate power could itself be oppressive privilege; his defense of them was conditional on their own mildness, and the inventory's objects must not be mistaken for an unquestionably pro-liberty alliance in value terms
modern_applications_zh: 组织预警仪表盘：为企业/机构设立『缓冲结构健康度』指标（审计独立性、工会或员工代表、申诉通道）并做事件时间线追踪
数字平台治理：监测社区自治模块（版主选举、申诉委员会）被平台直接接管的事件序列，作为社区走向独裁运营的预警
合规与风控：把『规则对高管是否同样适用』列为内控最高级审计项，『高层豁免』即专制信号
国际关系分析：对目标国追踪司法独立、媒体多元、地方自治三类中间权力的削弱序列，辅助政治风险评级
modern_applications_en: Organizational early-warning dashboard: set 'buffer-structure health' metrics for firms and institutions (audit independence, employee representation, appeal channels) with event-timeline tracking
Digital platform governance: monitor the sequence of platform takeover of community self-rule modules (moderator elections, appeal boards) as early warning of dictatorial operation
Compliance and risk: list 'do rules apply equally to executives' as the highest-level internal-control audit item; senior exemption is the despotism signal
International-risk analysis: track the weakening sequence of judicial independence, media pluralism, and local self-rule in target countries to inform political-risk ratings

modes.domain_zh: 把外国或古代制度视为候选移植体，移植前逐项检验其与本地原则、风俗、规模条件的相容性
modes.domain_en: Treating foreign or ancient institutions as transplant candidates whose compatibility with local principles, mores, and scale must be tested item by item before grafting
modes.definition_zh: 孟德斯鸠在《论法的精神》中反复处理一个工程问题：好的制度能否搬运？他的答案是条件化的：『如果一个国家的法律适合另一个国家，那纯属最大的巧合』——法律是特定情境的产物，因此制度移植必须像器官移植一样做配型检验。他亲自示范了正反两面：他赞美英格兰政体却不主张法国照搬，因为两国的原则（荣誉与德性）、规模与社会结构不同；他考察罗马经验时明确区分『罗马条件下成立』与『一般成立』。方法上有三步：其一，移植体解剖——把候选制度拆解为要件清单（它依赖的政体原则、社会经济条件、执行能力、文化预设），任何要件缺位都是潜在排异点；其二，受体配型——逐要件核对本地条件：本地的支配原则、风俗结构、规模、执行能力与移植体要件是否相容；其三，改造与分期方案——对不相容要件决定改造移植体还是改造受体，并把移植拆为分期过程，先落地最不依赖缺失要件的模块。这一方法的深意是：制度工程失败的最大来源不是选错了制度，而是跳过了配型——『别处成功』只证明该制度在其要件齐备处成功，不证明它在你处成功。
modes.definition_en: Throughout The Spirit of the Laws Montesquieu grapples with an engineering question: can good institutions be transplanted? His answer is conditional: 'if the laws of one country suit another, it is by the greatest of coincidences'—laws are products of particular situations, so institutional transplantation requires compatibility testing like organ grafting. He demonstrated both sides himself: he admired the English constitution without urging France to copy it, since their principles (honor versus virtue), scale, and social structure differed; in treating Roman experience he explicitly separated 'true under Roman conditions' from 'true in general.' The method has three steps. First, dissect the transplant: decompose the candidate institution into a checklist of requirements—the regime principle it presupposes, socioeconomic conditions, executive capacity, cultural assumptions; any missing requirement is a potential rejection point. Second, type the recipient: check each requirement against local conditions—is the local governing principle, mores structure, scale, and executive capacity compatible with the transplant's requirements? Third, adapt and stage: for incompatible requirements decide whether to modify the transplant or the recipient, and split the graft into phases, landing first the modules least dependent on missing requirements. The deeper point: the largest source of failure in institutional engineering is not choosing the wrong institution but skipping the compatibility test—that 'it succeeded elsewhere' proves only success where its requirements were met, not success where you stand.
modes.source_chapter: 《论法的精神》第二十九章 (De l'esprit des lois, XXIX, 1748)；《罗马盛衰原因论》的条件限定
modes.key_quote_zh: 如果一个国家的法律恰好适合另一个国家，那纯属最大的巧合。
modes.key_quote_en: If the laws of one country suited another, it would be the greatest of coincidences.
process_zh: 移植体解剖：把候选制度拆为要件清单——政体原则预设、社会经济条件、执行能力、文化预设
受体配型：逐要件核对本地条件，标记全部排异点并评估改造难度
改造决策：对每个排异点二选一——改造移植体使其适配，或先改造受体条件；无改造方案者放弃移植
分期落地：按『对缺失要件依赖度』排序模块，先落地最自持的模块，用早期成功积累后续移植的条件
process_en: Dissect the transplant: decompose the candidate into a requirements checklist—regime-principle presuppositions, socioeconomic conditions, executive capacity, cultural assumptions
Type the recipient: check each requirement against local conditions, marking every rejection point and estimating modification difficulty
Decide adaptations: for each rejection point choose to modify the transplant or the recipient's conditions; abandon grafts with no modification plan
Stage the landing: order modules by dependence on missing requirements, landing the most self-sustaining first, letting early success build conditions for later modules
representative_cases_zh: 他对英格兰政体的克制态度：尽管《论法的精神》以英格兰为自由政体范本，他从不主张法国照搬——法国的原则是荣誉而非德性，规模与社会分层都不同，照搬即排异
罗马经验的条件化引用：他引用罗马土地法与军事制度时反复标注『共和国早期』『公民平等尚在』等条件，示范了『在什么条件下成立』的引用纪律
封建制度的演化解释：他把法国封建法解释为日耳曼征服习惯与罗马晚期地产结构两个移植体在本地条件下的融合产物——一部活的移植适配史
反例警示：适配检验不等于拒绝一切借鉴——孟德斯鸠同样主张某些普遍原则（对权力的结构约束、刑罚温和化）跨情境有效；本方法约束的是『整套制度』的搬运，不禁止要件的跨情境征用
representative_cases_en: His restraint toward the English constitution: though The Spirit of the Laws takes England as the model of free government, he never urged France to copy it—France's principle is honor, not virtue, and its scale and stratification differ; copying means rejection

Conditional citation of Roman experience: in citing Roman land laws and military institutions he repeatedly tags the conditions—'early Republic,' 'while civic equality held'—demonstrating citation discipline of 'true under what conditions'

The evolutionary explanation of feudalism: he explained French feudal law as the fusion, under local conditions, of two transplants—Germanic conquest customs and late-Roman estate structures—a living history of transplant adaptation

Cautionary case: the adaptation test does not forbid all borrowing—he equally held certain universal principles (structural checks on power, mildness of punishment) valid across situations; the method constrains wholesale 'institution packages,' not the cross-situational borrowing of individual elements
modern_applications_zh: 跨国公司治理移植：把总部制度搬入新市场前做要件配型（本地劳动法、信任结构、执行成本），分模块落地而非整体切换
开源组件选型：评估引入某框架时列出其隐含要件（团队规模、运维能力、生态依赖），与自身条件逐项配型
教育改革设计：引入国外课程体系前先拆要件（师资、评价制度、家庭配合度），优先落地低依赖模块
个人方法论借鉴：采用他人工作法时先列其成立前提（时间结构、助理支持、行业节奏），改造后再用
modern_applications_en: Multinational governance transplant: before moving headquarters systems into a new market, run requirements typing (local labor law, trust structures, execution costs) and land modules rather than switching wholesale
Open-source component selection: when evaluating a framework, list its implicit requirements (team size, ops capability, ecosystem dependencies) and type them against your own conditions item by item
Education-reform design: before importing a foreign curriculum, decompose requirements (teachers, assessment system, family cooperation) and land low-dependence modules first
Personal method borrowing: before adopting someone's work method, list its enabling premises (time structure, assistant support, industry rhythm) and adapt before use
